تجتبون (form VIII)
# تَجْتَبُونَ (tajtabūna) /tad͡ʒ.ta.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
# تُجْتَبَوْنَ (tujtabawna) /tud͡ʒ.ta.baw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
